searchText: Conservative estimates are that the bomb will be delayed to allow for additional testing and polishing but it’ll be the last delay and it likely will be less than 6 months. Why `""` and not `"0x"`? Current API specs indicate `0x` https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/blob/4aeeb165bc5f9695938bb2f84170d1f92ce16bf5/types/primitive.yaml#L93 And as an implementer it makes it simpler to render Should there be something like the spec tests but for the beacon REST API? While not mission critical, incompatibilities are very annoying for downstream consumers do someone know how ETH 1 Block Cache works on Lighthouse seems broken on Erigon... what does it consists of? TTD is projected to occur at ~2PM UTC on Monday. I don't think there's a live watching planned for it this time 😅 Hmm... that's ugly, but if it's in the spec I guess we're stuck with it. (`0x` was, as far as I was always aware shorthand for "the following digits should be interpreted as base 16". If there are no following digits it seems redundant at best.) There are a bunch of tests that can be run against nodes at https://github.com/attestantio/go-eth2-client but the client is designed to be a bit more forgiving of deviations from the spec they wouldn't work perfectly as conformity tests. Nimbus has some beacon API tests as well -- https://github.com/status-im/nimbus-eth2/blob/stable/ncli/resttest.nim and https://github.com/status-im/nimbus-eth2/blob/stable/ncli/resttest-rules.json
